newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu, Meridor, Frenkel to meet on shekel.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu, Meridor, Frenkel to meet on shekel.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Israel's finance minister and the head of the Bank of Israel will meet on Tuesday afternoon to continue talks on the thorny issue of widening the shekel's trading band.
Netanyahu's spokesman in an announcement to the media said the three would meet at 1130 GMT at the prime minister's office in Jerusalem. He said the meeting would not be open to media coverage.

Netanyahu said earlier on Tuesday after a marathon all-night meeting that an agreement had been reached with Bank of Israel Governor Jacob Frenkel and Finance Minister Dan Meridor on a foreign currency reform.
In remarks broadcast on Israel Radio he said an additional budget cut had also been agreed during the meeting at Caesarea. But no decision had been reached yet on widening the shekel's trading band.
